title: Add Strings
description: Add two non-negative numbers represented as strings without converting to integers.

data.text: Given two non-negative integers `num1` and `num2` as strings, return the sum of `num1` and `num2` as a string without using built-in big-integer libraries.

data.title: Digit-by-digit O(max(n,m))
Prepend chars O(max(n,m))
What improved?
data.text: Instead of building the string backwards and reversing at the end, we insert at the front. For typical small sums this is negligible, but it removes one extra copy.
